snippet.title: Railway Chai Wala // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3531970/Railway_Chai_Wala

Step into the world of Ramu, a spirited railway chaiwala at the bustling Fakripur station. Life isn’t just about brewing chai—it’s steeped in mystery! Uncover dark, masala-filled secrets in this Psychological Thriller Game with a blend of suspense and Indian flavor!

👥 Players: Single Player
🛠️ Developer: DRCOCKTAIL GAMES LLP
📚 Publisher: DRCOCKTAIL GAMES LLP
📅 Release Date: Mar 7, 2025
🎯 Genre: Casual, Indie, Simulation, Free To Play
